summary: Closure review: the revised manuscript presents a sealed, preregistered paired study with complete archived artifacts and internally consistent analysis showing near‑null marginal verifier+single‑repair effect under shared_initial_candidate semantics (N=250 pairs). However the three prior required editorial/disclosure items remain unresolved: (1) the Disclosure Statement still includes extensive per-file paths and many full hashes instead of a concise manifest pointer; (2) the Abstract does not explicitly state that the preregistered sim‑to‑real/production-like confirmatory contrast was not executed; and (3) the References are not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full metadata and verified in‑text numeric citations. These unresolved items must be fixed before finalisation.
critical_issues: Disclosure Statement still duplicates low-level execution bookkeeping (per-file paths and many full artifact hashes) rather than providing a concise manifest pointer; this violates the track guidance and must be condensed in the main manuscript.

Abstract omits an explicit, prominent statement that the preregistered sim‑to‑real/production-like confirmatory contrast was not executed and that the reported confirmatory estimand applies only to the synthetic/emulation partition; this must appear in the Abstract.

References are not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full bibliographic metadata and verified semantic support for each proximate in-text citation; identifier-only entries must be converted into full IEEE entries and in-text numeric citations must correctly map to and support the cited claims.
required_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement in the main manuscript: remove per-file paths and per-artifact full hashes from the paper body, replace them with one concise manifest pointer (single archive locator or short SHA-256 manifest identifier) referencing the archived evidence bundle, and move file-level bookkeeping into the archived bundle. Ensure the Disclosure remains within pages 1–5 and is not a second Methods/Results section.

Add an explicit sentence to the Abstract that the preregistered sim‑to‑real/production-like confirmatory contrast was not executed and that the reported confirmatory estimand/inference applies only to the synthetic/emulation partition run.

Ensure the References section is a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/URL where available). Replace any identifier-only entries with full bibliographic entries and verify that every in-text numeric citation corresponds to the correct reference and actually supports the proximate scholarly claim.
optional_revisions: Shorten and focus Related Work to the most closely adjacent papers (e.g., Verified Prompt Programming [citation], Batfish evolution [citation], NetConfEval [citation]) and explicitly compare how the shared_initial_candidate paired design differs from prior GVR evaluations.

Add a succinct mapping (one short paragraph or small diagram) that links adapter/provider audit labels (e.g., condition_counts and stage_counts) to pipeline stages (initial generation, validator check, repair) to aid reader comprehension; keep this mapping concise and do not include raw artifact paths.

Add a one-line explicit callout in Limitations noting that the realized baseline pass-rate (0.996) departed from the preregistered power assumption (~0.90), reducing power to detect small absolute improvements.
